subject: Clarify SOC 2 report day boundaries and month-end snapshot evidence
messages:
From: Emily Dawson <emily.dawson@zephyrcloud.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@zephyrcloud.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:12:47 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 timeframe / month-end snapshot question for purchase order

Hi Rachel,

We're preparing the security review for our procurement team and have two quick clarifications on Redwood's SOC 2 Type II materials before we proceed:

1) The report you provided is labeled as covering "period: 2025-09-01 through 2026-08-31" — can you confirm whether that means August 31 is inclusive (i.e., full-day coverage through 23:59:59 on Aug 31 UTC), or whether your auditors treat the final day as exclusive? Our legal wants exact wording for the procurement packet.

2) Separately, Zephyr requires a clear definition of what you mean by a "month-end snapshot / point-in-time" for evidence (logs, ACL snapshots). Do your point-in-time extracts use UTC end-of-day, local TZ, or service-specific cutoffs? We have an internal deadline to finalize the security binder by 2026-09-24; if there is any gap we may need a bridge letter.

Can you confirm and, if available, attach any short guidance or bridge language so my contracts team can review? If it's easier, we can set up a 20-minute call early next week.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Dawson
Senior Procurement Manager | Zephyr Cloud

Quick answers from my side: I attached our latest SOC 2 Type II report and the bridge-letter template we typically share for short gaps. Neha/Vivek — can you confirm the exact definition used in our report for "period end" and the default timestamp used for point-in-time evidence exports?

If Zephyr needs an explicit signed bridge letter for Sep-2026 coverage, we can produce a short one; would you prefer Redwood-signed only, or Redwood + auditor acknowledgement?

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Emily Dawson <emily.dawson@zephyrcloud.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 11:27:05 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 timeframe / month-end snapshot question for purchase order

Hi team — quick technical confirmation to help Zephyr's legal and procurement: 

1) "Inclusive final day": Our SOC 2 Type II report is prepared on the basis that the test period includes the full final day listed in the report (i.e., coverage through 23:59:59 UTC on 2026-08-31). That is the language we use in our standard report copy.

2) "Point-in-time / month-end snapshots": For operational evidence (system logs, ACL snapshots, config exports) our engineering exports are taken at 23:59:00 UTC by default for month-end snapshots; logging systems retain event timestamps in UTC. For certain services that operate in customer-specific regions we may provide region-specific exports — let us know if you need a region-aware snapshot.

3) Bridge letter: We can provide a short bridge letter to cover the gap from 2026-09-01 to the next audited period. Our template (attached) includes two options: (A) Redwood attestation only, or (B) Redwood attestation plus an auditor acknowledgement paragraph. Option B requires a quick sign-off from Secure Audits (they typically append a short paragraph rather than re-auditing).

Action items: 
- Emily: please confirm which bridge option Zephyr prefers (A or B) and whether you require region-specific snapshots.
- Rachel / Priyom: if Zephyr wants option B, I'll coordinate with Secure Audits to confirm the wording; should be a 1-2 business day turnaround.

Attachments referenced: SOC2-TypeII-2025-09_to_2026-08.pdf (report), SOC2-BridgeLetter-template.docx

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference

From: Secure Audits LLP <audit-team@secureaudits.com>
To: Emily Dawson <emily.dawson@zephyrcloud.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 timeframe / month-end snapshot question for purchase order

Hi Emily and team,

Secure Audits LLP here — we performed the SOC 2 Type II engagement for Redwood for the 2025-09-01 through 2026-08-31 period. A couple of points from the auditor perspective: 

- Standard practice: the period dates printed on the report are inclusive. We treat the final listed day as included in the tests (i.e., coverage through 23:59:59 UTC on the final date).

- Point-in-time evidence: auditors accept server-side exports taken at end-of-day timestamps; using UTC end-of-day (23:59:00 to 23:59:59) is a clear, defensible approach. Please note that the exact second is less material than consistent, documented practice.

- Bridge letter: We are happy to provide a short acknowledgement paragraph if Zephyr requests auditor-acknowledged bridge language. Our addition is typically a single paragraph stating that we acknowledge Redwood's representation for the interim period (dates are specified) and that we do not object to the customer using a vendor-provided bridge letter for procurement purposes. This is standard and does not require re-testing. We can return the signed paragraph within 48 hours of receiving the final draft.

If it helps, I'm available for a 15-minute call with Zephyr legal to confirm wording — propose Tue 09/21 08:00–09:00 PDT.

Regards,
Daniel Ortiz
Engagement Partner | Secure Audits LLP
audit-team@secureaudits.com
